build_steps.description: Install system packages: git, curl, xvfb, npm, google-chrome-stable
Copy repo_setup.sh from build context to /opt/benchmark/repo_setup.sh
Copy setup_runtime.sh from build context to /opt/benchmark/setup_runtime.sh
Execute repo_setup.sh to clone PlayCanvas engine repository
Execute setup_runtime.sh to install npm dependencies

repo_setup_integration.purpose: Clone PlayCanvas engine repository at specific commit

verifier_packaging.note: Verifier assets (eval.sh, tests/) are NOT baked into the image. They are mounted at runtime by the orchestrator.

eval_sh.note: Not copied into image - mounted at runtime

tests.note: Not copied into image - mounted at runtime

fix_patch.note: NOT included in buggy image - only for fixed image variant

notes: Dockerfile built for PlayCanvas WebGL engine benchmark. Chrome and xvfb required for Karma browser tests. ESM modules supported via Node.js 18.x.
